# Synthetic process checks only. No model generation or real user outcome.
exec pinax init vault --title Research --json
exec sh -c 'pinax note add "Local Index" --slug local-index --stdin --vault vault --json < index.md'
cp stdout created.json
source-id created.json
exec sh -c 'pinax note add "External Retrieval" --slug external-retrieval --stdin --vault vault --json < external.md'
exec pinax index refresh --vault vault --json
vault-digest vault before.sha
next-second

# Candidate lookup, rephrasing and bounded multi-source discovery.
exec pinax search lexical --limit 1 --lazy-index off --vault vault --agent
stdout 'fact.returned=1'
stdout 'local-index.md'
exec pinax search embeddings --limit 2 --lazy-index off --vault vault --agent
stdout 'external-retrieval.md'
exec pinax search comparison --limit 2 --lazy-index off --vault vault --agent
stdout 'fact.returned=2'
exec pinax search nonexistent-evidence --lazy-index off --vault vault --agent
stdout 'fact.returned=0'
exec pinax search lexical --lazy-index ' off ' --vault vault --agent
stdout 'fact.lazy_index=off'

# Sources must be opened explicitly; conflicting statements remain distinguishable.
exec pinax note show $SOURCE_ID --view source --display body --vault vault --json
stdout 'lexical indexing'
stdout 'source-notes-only'
exec pinax note show external-retrieval --view source --display body --vault vault --json
stdout 'semantic retrieval'
stdout 'source-evaluation-missing'
exec pinax note backlinks local-index --vault vault --json
stdout 'external-retrieval.md'
! exec pinax note show missing-source --view source --display body --vault vault --json
stdout '"status":"failed"'
vault-digest vault after.sha
cmp before.sha after.sha

# A missing index falls back without creating an index or changing source state.
rm vault/.pinax/index.sqlite
vault-digest vault missing-index.sha
exec pinax search comparison --engine auto --lazy-index off --limit 2 --vault vault --agent
stdout 'fact.engine=native'
stdout 'fact.returned=2'
vault-digest vault after-fallback.sha
cmp missing-index.sha after-fallback.sha

# Unaccepted output and dry-run must not create a note or receipt.
exec sh -c 'pinax note add "Decision Brief" --slug decision-brief --dir index --stdin --dry-run --vault vault --json < brief.md'
! exists vault/notes/index/decision-brief.md
vault-digest vault after-preview.sha
cmp missing-index.sha after-preview.sha

# Simulated acceptance persists through the CLI, then verifies source backlinks.
exec sh -c 'pinax note add "Decision Brief" --slug decision-brief --dir index --stdin --vault vault --json < brief.md'
exists vault/notes/index/decision-brief.md
exec pinax search 'Decision Brief' --engine native --lazy-index off --vault vault --agent
stdout 'decision-brief.md'
exec pinax note backlinks local-index --vault vault --json
stdout 'decision-brief.md'

# Moving a source retains identity; reading after deletion reports the missing source.
exec pinax note rename $SOURCE_ID 'Local Index Revised' --vault vault --json
exec pinax note show $SOURCE_ID --view source --display body --vault vault --json
stdout 'Local Index Revised'
stdout 'lexical indexing'
exec pinax note delete $SOURCE_ID --yes --vault vault --json
! exec pinax note show $SOURCE_ID --view source --display body --vault vault --json
stdout '"status":"failed"'

# Deterministic storage failure: a file occupies the requested parent directory.
cp blocker.txt vault/notes/blocked
vault-digest vault before-failure.sha
! exec pinax note add 'Failed Brief' --dir blocked --stdin --vault vault --json < brief.md
stdout '"status":"failed"'
vault-digest vault after-failure.sha
cmp before-failure.sha after-failure.sha

-- index.md --
# Local Index
For the synthetic comparison, prefer lexical indexing for local source-notes-only use.
Evidence date: unknown. This note makes no claim about current external products.

-- external.md --
# External Retrieval
For the synthetic comparison, consider semantic retrieval with embeddings.
This contradicts [[local-index]] on the preferred next step: source-evaluation-missing.
Evidence date: unknown. More evaluation is needed before choosing.

-- brief.md --
# Decision Brief
Synthetic fixture, not an Agent-generated result and not a real accepted decision.
Use the local baseline first; semantic retrieval remains an unvalidated alternative.
Sources: [[local-index]] and [[external-retrieval]]. Source dates are unknown.
Template reference only: research/evidence-research-brief-beta@2.0.0-beta.1 (en).
No Registry compilation or repeatable model generation is claimed.

-- blocker.txt --
This file deliberately blocks a fixture-only destination directory.
